questions.question: The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 2 : 5. If the first train runs 250 km in 5 h, then the sum of the speeds (in km/ h) of both the trains is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 2 : 5

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of two trains be 2x and 5x

Speed of first train = 250/5 = 50 km/h

⇒ 2x = 50

⇒ x = 25 km/h

The sum of the speeds of both train = 2x + 5x = 7x = 7 × 25 = 175 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 175 km/h.**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab (a - b)

Calculation:

x – 1/x = 7

Cubing both sides

⇒ (x – 1/x)³ = (7)³

{x³} - (1)/({{x³)}} - 3 ( {x - (1)/(x)} ) = 343 

{x³} - (1)/({{x³)}} - 3 × 7 = 343

{x³} - (1)/({{x³)}} = 343 + 21 

{x³} - (1)/({{x³)}} = 364

**∴ The correct answer is 364.**

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is a diameter of the circle circumscribing it and angle ADC = 146°. ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral.

AB is a diameter of the circle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6da44e4e0bfa9cb41e28646609d54122c367b7b16b89291f4108cc3847b99ebe.png] 

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180° [cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle is 180°]

⇒ 146° + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° − 146° = 34°

In ∆ABC

∴ ∠ACB = 90° [angle made by diameter = 90°]

∴ ∠BAC = 180° − (90° + 34°)

⇒ 180° − 124° = 56° 

**∴ The correct answer is 56°.**

questions.question: If sec θ = 8 x and tan θ = 8/x (x ≠ 0), then the value of 16 (x² − 1/x²) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec θ = 8x; tan θ = 8/x

**Formula used:**

sec2θ - tan2 θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ (8x)2 – (8/x)2 = sec2θ − tan2 θ

⇒ 64x² – 64/x² = sec2θ − tan2 θ

⇒ 64 (x² – 1/x²) = 1

⇒ 64 (x² – 1/x²) = 1

Dividing both sides by 4

⇒ 16 (x² – 1/x²) = 1/4

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

questions.question: A earns Rs. 100 per hour and works for 8 hours per day. B earns Rs. 120 per hour and works for 6 hours per day. The ratio of per day wages of B to that of A is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A earns Rs. 100 per hour and works for 8 hours per day.

B earns Rs. 120 per hour and works for 6 hours per day.

**Calculation:**

B earns per day = 120 × 6

A earns per day = 100 × 8

Required ratio = 120 × 6 : 100 × 8 = 9 : 10

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 10.**

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money at 21% for 2 years is Rs. 11,602.5. Its simple interest (in Rs.) at the same rate and for the same period is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

C.I = Rs. 11,602.5, rate = 21%, time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Compound interest = P [(1 + r/100)n – 1]

Where,

P = Principal amount, r = Rate of interest, n = Number of years

**Calculation:**

Compound interest = P × [(1 + r/100)n – 1]

⇒ 11,602.5 = P × [(1 + 21/100)2 – 1]

⇒ 11,602.5 = P × [1.4641 - 1]

⇒ 11,602.5 = P × 0.4641

⇒ P = 25000

Now, 

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (25000 × 21 × 2)/100

⇒ 10,500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.10,500.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

Effective rate for 2 years at 21% = 46.41%

So, P × 46.41% = 11,602.5

⇒ P = (11,602.5/46.41) × 100

⇒ P = 25000

Now, 

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (25000 × 21 × 2)/100

⇒ 10,500

∴ The correct answer is Rs.10,500.

questions.question: The distance between the centers of two circles of a radius of 6 cm each is 13 cm. The length (in cm) of a transverse common tangent is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between center(d) = 13 cm

r1 = 6 cm and r2 = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of transverse common tangent = √{d² - (r₁ + r₂)²} 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba30640866494cf1a0a3e00564e5331955c72bf4688b1716b6312582390a3c3.png] 

Length of transverse common tangent = √{d2 - (r1 + r2)2} 

Length of transverse tangent = √{(13)2 - (6 + 6)2} 

⇒ √{169 - 144} = √25 = 5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cm.**

questions.question: A dealer buys an article marked at Rs. 5000 with two successive discounts of 20% and 5%. He spends Rs. 200 on repairs and sells it for Rs. 5000, what is his profit/loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

CP for dealer = 5000 × (80/100) × (95/100) = Rs. 3800

After spending Rs. 200 on repairs

Total CP for dealer = 3800 + 200 = Rs. 4000

SP of dealer = Rs. 5000

Profit = 5000 – 4000 = Rs. 1000

Profit percentage = (1000/4000) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

questions.question: The sum of the salaries of A and B is Rs. 42,000. A spends 75% of his salary and B spends 90% of his salary. Now their savings are the same. What is A’s salary (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the salaries of A and B is Rs. 42,000.

A spends 75% of his salary and B spends 90% of his salary.

Their savings are the equal.

**Calculation:**

Since their savings are same

∴ A × 25% = B × 10%

⇒ 5 A = 2 B

⇒ A/B = 2/5

Let the salaries of A and B be 2x and 5x respectively

∴ 2x + 5x = 42,000

⇒ 7x = 42,000

⇒ x = 6,000

Salary of A = 2 × 6000 = Rs. 12000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12000.**

questions.question: A man bought three articles for Rs. 6,000 each. He sold the article respectively at 15% profit, 12% profit and 15% loss. The total percentage profit/loss he earned is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man bought three articles for Rs. 6,000 each.

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of each article = 100.

Total CP of 3 articles = 300

SP of first article = 100 × 115/100 = 115

SP of second article = 100 × 112/100 = 112

SP of third article = 100 × 85/100 = 85

Total CP of 3 articles = 115 + 112 + 85 = Rs. 312

Profit = 312 – 300 = Rs. 12

Profit Percentage = (12/300) × 100 = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**
